resources.string: Opens Android’s recent apps when you select Recents on Home. No screen content, typing, app history or accessibility events are read or stored. Android owns task dismissal; this shortcut does not force stop apps. Disable here any time.

Optional D-pad Recent apps view. When you open it, reads Android SystemUI task names and control buttons to offer Open, Close and confirmed Clear all. Receives SystemUI window-change notifications; their contents are ignored. No screenshots, typing, other app screens or key filtering. Task information stays in memory while the view is open; nothing is saved or uploaded. Android grants screen-content access for this feature. It does not force stop background services. Disable here any time.
